reviews.title: Charging for Features That Were Free
reviews.text: I really liked this app, but their new policy of charging for previously free features is ridiculous. I’ve been using the tide widget for months now but now it’s completely bricked until I pay $20 a year.

reviews.title: New paywall strips features
reviews.text: Tide Alert used to have home-screen widgets for all users, but has put this basic system functionality behind a new paywall. Screwing over existing users by paywalling existing features is hostile and greedy. 5 stars down to 1. Find another app, there’s plenty using this NOAA data.

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: Great design, the app used to have widgets available for free but now they’ve put those features behind a paywall. Deleted the app and found one with those features free. Don’t screw over your users by removing features from free accounts.

reviews.title: Show the windspeed
reviews.text: Sometimes it shows up on the main tide screen sometimes it doesnt show up on the main tide screen!.. very…very annoying why cant it show the wind all the time why is it intermittent worst part is i paid for this app

reviews.title: They cut back on features on the free app
reviews.text: The app is not letting me view the tidal waves and displays purchase options

reviews.title: Ripoff
reviews.text: $20 a year to have an app pull publicly available info is a scam.

reviews.title: Good App but Eventually Requires Payment
reviews.text: I used the app and widget for months before it seemingly out of nowhere put up a paywall asking for payment. Paying for to continue using the app wasn’t worth it for me because (1) it presents free information sourced from NOAA and (2) there are comparable apps for free on the App Store.
